When asked in April 2025, Trump's first three months were rated at 61% approval by Oklahoman polltakers. Now in August 2026, Trump remains at 52% approval in Oklahoma.

Nationally, Trump has an unfavorable majority across all ages, education levels, genders, and races. Trump's only favorability among Civiqs' demographics is found in the 82% of Republicans who remain faithful to the president. results.content:
## How Americans feel about Trump personally

Favorability polling is different. It focuses on how voters feel about the person in general.

National Civiqs' favorability data shows 58% of voters have a negative outlook on the president. About 38% of people viewed him favorably as of July 31. Mississippi polling mirrors those results.

YouGov's poll for The Economist says Trump stands at 56.8% unfavorable, 42.3% favorable, and 0.8% don't know as of July 13. [...] Since April, Mississippi voters have been almost evenly split on Trump. But in early June, his disapproval rating edged above his approval rating. Since then, approval has gradually declined while disapproval has steadily increased.
